overall_validity.rationale: Key variables and rules—including hierarchical turn-taking, dominance of senior actors, task-only role for the analytics assistant, strict formality, on-schedule but efficiency-focused pacing, and absence of social rewards—are instantiated very faithfully in both narration and dialogue.
